@michael-ciniawsky Sorry! Didn't notice this change at first. I removed it in the latest commit, this is no longer in the branch.

When I was testing with the `schema-utils` installed from the git tag version, I had to build it manually inside of `node_modules` and somehow build step added this line to `package.json`, still don't really understand why this happened 😅
`SourceMap DevTool Plugin` ?
Please use just one tab for indent
If this is just github displaying tabs `\t` weirdly forget what I said then 😛

I think this is just a github issue 😸 

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/5036933/32646409-bc26b7ce-c5ec-11e7-95dc-0f7a94d3937a.png)

Did you mean this messages by 'not good ' ? 😛 These are `defaults` ? Do we need them ? Based on the `webpack.config.js` I only expected `"options['foo'] should NOT have additional properties"` here, but that's up to sokra to decide

Yes, this and the actual error messaging format is not very good. 

In this case, `oneOf` is the reason for these error messages: CommonsChunkPlugin options could be a string, array or object and AJV reports errors on every `oneOf` as if all of them failed. 

This happens in the webpackOptionValidation too, but the [error messaging there is changed](https://github.com/webpack/webpack/blob/master/lib/WebpackOptionsValidationError.js#L144) in a way, that will print this error more nicely. It will look something like this:

```
options has an unknown property 'foo'

options should be one of these:
* string
* array[string]
* { <object schema> }
```
I think all `function()` could be refactored to an arrow, but that's entirely additional chore so feel free to ignore 😛

```diff
- function testAssertions(code, stdout, stderr) 
+ function(code, stdout, stderr) 
```

We can definitely handle `anyOf, oneOf, default` etc in a better way with better messages, `schema-utils` does the minimum atm. If you have something in mind feel free to open an issue or PR if you have the time
